# CineScope — Movies & TV Series Guide

> CineScope is a legal movie and TV series discovery guide for the US and Europe.
> 334 real titles (60 curated + 274 from the TVMaze API catalog — one duplicate "Utopia" title is dropped by the catalog merge). It publishes a
> Netflix Top 10 popularity snapshot, the official US and UK Apple TV movie charts,
> best-of-2026 and best-by-genre lists, and where-to-watch-legally guidance.
> CineScope hosts no streams and no downloads; every title links to its official provider.
> Canonical: https://cinescope-5g7u.onrender.com
> Updated: 15 Nov 2026 (series snapshot); movie charts snapshot 14 Nov 2026.

## Key pages
- / — Home: featured titles, Netflix Top 10, US & UK charts, mood picker, fresh guides hub
- /netflix/ — Netflix Top 10 series, week of 10-16 Nov 2026 (TVMaze-popularity snapshot, 15 Nov 2026 — NOT Netflix's official chart)
- /best-2026/ — Best movies of 2026: 26 real chart titles (20 US + 6 UK)
- /what-to-watch-tonight/ — What to watch on Netflix tonight (3 picks for 15 Nov 2026 + 30-second chooser)
- /best-thriller-series-netflix-2026/ — Best thriller series on Netflix 2026 (6 Netflix thrillers + more top-rated thrillers)
- /where-to-watch-top10-usa/ — Where to watch the Netflix Top 10 legally in the USA
- /usa/ — Best for US viewers · /uk/ — Best for UK viewers
- /movies/ — US & UK movie charts · /series/ — Top-rated series · /catalog/ — All 334 titles
- /genres/ — Browse by genre · /genre/thriller/ · /genre/comedy/ · /genre/drama/ · /genre/action/ · /genre/sci-fi/ · /genre/horror/ — Best-of lists by genre
- /where-to-watch/ — Where to watch legally (USA / UK / EU) · /where-to-watch/usa/ · /where-to-watch/uk/ · /where-to-watch/eu/
- /new-this-week/ — New this week: 27 titles (26 from 2026 + Jurassic World: Rebirth, 2025)
- /guides/ — Guides, FAQ, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt
- /titles/<slug>/ — One page per title (25 titles at launch: the Netflix Top 10, the 10 highest-rated series and the 5 chart-leading movies)

## Facts
- #1 in the Netflix popularity snapshot (15 Nov 2026): Black Mirror (TVMaze weight 100, rating 8.4)
- #2: Marvel's Daredevil (weight 99, 8.4) · #3: Arrested Development (99, 8.2) · #4: House of Cards (99, 8.2, new) · #8: Orange Is the New Black (98, 7.9, new)
- Ranking method: TVMaze popularity weight, ties broken by audience rating, then alphabetically. NOT Netflix's official daily chart.
- Highest-rated title in catalog: Breaking Bad (9.2); Band of Brothers and Firefly follow at 9.0.
- Best movie of 2026 in catalog: Heart of the Beast (#1 US Apple TV chart); highest 2026 title on UK chart: Savage House (#2)
- Data sources: TVMaze API (series), Apple iTunes charts US & UK (movies), official YouTube trailers
- Markets: United States and Europe (UK chart). English only — no DE/FR/ES pages exist yet.
- What CineScope is: a legal discovery guide. What it is NOT: a streaming site — no streams, no downloads, no pirated content.

## Note
- All pages listed above are real paths with their own server-rendered content (no hash routes). The sitemap lists the same 49 URLs.
- The static build serves the frozen 15 Nov 2026 snapshot; the live TVMaze refresh is disabled, so counts stay at 334 titles until the next rebuild.

- Dashboard: https://cinescope-5g7u.onrender.com/dashboard/ — visitor stats (per-browser, privacy-friendly). Not indexed.
